name: Quicken / two-tokens-two-trigger-layers-single-go-again
notes: Both existing Quicken tokens trigger independently from the same attack play. Initially Stack3/Arena2 and no grant. Resolve one: Stack2/Arena1 and grantGO_AGAIN.
